subject: Candlekeep
fact: Candlekeep's grounds are blanketed in snow, white and silent, with no hunting presence.
source_quote: Candlekeep's grounds were blanketed in it, white and silent, the kind of silence that had nothing hunting inside it.

subject: Candlekeep
fact: Candlekeep has three visible archways, one service passage, and one guarded door to the north.
source_quote: Exits: three visible archways, one service passage, one guarded door to the north.

subject: Candlekeep
fact: Candlekeep has an exaltation bastion as the dominant structure, tallest fixed point.
source_quote: The exaltation bastion rose above us and I filed it as the dominant structure, tallest fixed point.

subject: Astronomicon
fact: The Astronomicon is a stack of blue globes ascending in scale, pale against the white sky.
source_quote: You see that curious blue stack of globes? That's the Astronomicon.

subject: Whispering Dome
fact: The Whispering Dome is gold under the snow and part of the Hall of Momentous Deeds.
source_quote: The Whispering Dome sat further along, gold under the snow — striking, even by surface standards. Fembris pointed it out as part of the Hall of Momentous Deeds.

subject: Whispering Dome
fact: Voices from the past linger in the Whispering Dome and can be heard if one stands in the right place.
source_quote: explained that voices from the past lingered there, that you could hear them if you stood in the right place.

subject: Drakonoikos
fact: The Drakonoikos is built from enormous overlapping scales and bones worked into the walls.
source_quote: The structure was built from scales — actual scales, enormous, overlapping — and bones worked into the walls where another building would have used stone.

subject: Fyrentennimar
fact: Fyrentennimar is a dragon of age and significance whose remains form the Drakonoikos.
source_quote: Fyrentennimar, Fembris finally produced the name after a pause and a visible effort, dragon of some age and significance, now a wall.

subject: Dragon Breath Simulation Chamber
fact: The Dragon Breath Simulation Chamber is inside the Drakonoikos and caused the death of one Avowed.
source_quote: Fembris warned us about the Dragon Breath Simulation Chamber inside. One of the Avowed had died in it, he said.

subject: oil paintings
fact: Oil paintings of stern-faced sages in various states of disapproval line every staircase in the Candlekeep bastion.
source_quote: Oil paintings on every staircase, stern-faced sages in various states of disapproval

subject: busts
fact: Busts on pedestals are positioned at each landing in the Candlekeep bastion.
source_quote: busts on pedestals at each landing.

subject: tapestries
fact: Heavy tapestries hang in the Candlekeep bastion and could conceal anything or nothing.
source_quote: The tapestries were heavy and could conceal anything or nothing.

subject: Chapter House
fact: The Chapter House contains twelve chairs around a twelve-sided table.
source_quote: The Chapter House was exactly as described — twelve chairs around a twelve-sided table

subject: Chapter House
fact: The Chapter House has a rose window throwing colored light across the stone floor.
source_quote: rose window throwing colored light across the stone floor

subject: Chapter House
fact: The Chapter House has western gables pressing down overhead like a building that takes itself seriously.
source_quote: western gables pressing down overhead like a building that took itself seriously.

subject: A'lai Aivenmore
fact: A'lai Aivenmore is a tall, handsome council member with a braided beard who advocates for restoring leadership to Candlekeep.
source_quote: We must have the vote and restore leadership to Candlekeep." That was A'lai Aivenmore — tall, handsome, braided beard, the kind of smooth presentation that means either he's been waiting for this moment or he's very good at pretending he hasn't.

subject: halfling with pince-nez
fact: A dowdy halfling with pince-nez argues that Janussi's successor must be determined first.
source_quote: First, we must determine if Janussi named a successor—" The dowdy halfling with the pince-nez. She adjusted her glasses as she said it.

subject: slender human with heavy wrinkles
fact: A slender human with heavy wrinkles insists the murderer must be found first.
source_quote: First, we must find the murderer!" The slender human with the heavy wrinkles, voice sharp enough to cut. She at least had the right priority.

subject: bronze dragonborn in bejeweled robes
fact: A bronze dragonborn in bejeweled robes demands the gate warden be dismissed immediately.
source_quote: The gate warden needs to be dismissed with immediate effect! This happened on HIS watch!" That was the bronze dragonborn in the bejeweled robes — formidably sized, beautifully tailored, entirely aware of both facts.

subject: Daral
fact: Daral questions why Sylvira Savikas is absent from the Council meeting.
source_quote: why isn't Sylvira Savikas here?

subject: Bookwyrm
fact: Bookwyrm is a green dragonborn who is shaken and weary from being awake since Janussi's death.
source_quote: Bookwyrm was trying to hold it together. Green dragonborn, shaken, weary in the way you get when you've been awake since someone died and also people keep talking.

subject: Grygum
fact: Grygum declares himself the founder of the Grygumite School to gain the council's attention.
source_quote: I am the head of the Grygumite School." A beat. "Founder, in fact.

subject: Thorin
fact: Thorin mentions he and his wife have been watching a great deal of Poirot lately.
source_quote: Thorin noted that he and his wife had been watching a great deal of Poirot lately.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer, housed in her scabbard, claims to be the greatest discoverer of all for having been found after two thousand years.
source_quote: Dawnbringer, housed in her scabbard, took the opportunity to note that we must surely be the greatest discoverers of all, having found her tomb after two thousand years.

subject: Kalan Strongbranch
fact: Kalan Strongbranch has a gray-white beard, piercing blue eyes, and expects to be listened to.
source_quote: Kalan Strongbranch walked in. I recognized him — the gray-white beard, the piercing blue eyes, the posture of someone who expects to be listened to and usually is.

subject: Kalan Strongbranch
fact: Kalan Strongbranch previously wanted to put Daz in irons upon arrival at Candlekeep.
source_quote: He'd been the one who wanted to put Daz in irons when we arrived.

subject: Janussi's resignation request
fact: Janussi asked Kalan Strongbranch to tender his resignation the morning before his death.
source_quote: yesterday morning, Janussi asked the gate warden to tender his resignation.

subject: Bookwyrm's disclosure
fact: Bookwyrm disclosed that Janussi was concerned Kalan was losing his mental faculties and becoming negligent.
source_quote: The Keeper was concerned that Kalan was losing his mental faculties and becoming negligent in his work.

subject: investigation delegation
fact: Bookwyrm proposed delegating the investigation into Janussi's death to the party.
source_quote: Bookwyrm proposed delegating the investigation to us.

subject: remuneration agreement
fact: The council agreed to provide one book each to the party upon successful completion of the investigation.
source_quote: One book each, copied at the House of the Binder, upon successful completion.

subject: confidentiality papers
fact: The council required confidentiality papers before granting the party access to the investigation.
source_quote: Confidentiality papers first.

subject: all-access library card request
fact: The party requested and received carte blanche access to the entire Candlekeep library.
source_quote: We need an all-access library card," I said. [...] Bookwyrm agreed.

subject: Kalan Strongbranch's entrance
fact: Kalan Strongbranch entered the Chapter House and was immediately cut off by Bookwyrm.
source_quote: Then Kalan Strongbranch walked in. [...] Before he could speak, Bookwyrm cut him off with the precision of someone who had prepared that sentence in advance

subject: Bookwyrm's assurance
fact: Bookwyrm assured the party she had nothing to do with Janussi's death.
source_quote: I can assure you, I had nothing to do with it.

subject: Sylvira Savikas
fact: Sylvira Savikas is absent from the Council meeting and her absence is questioned by Daral.
source_quote: why isn't Sylvira Savikas here?

subject: Brother Heslin
fact: Brother Heslin once spoke about repurposing threats as knowledge, according to Zalthir's memory.
source_quote: Brother Heslin — or possibly Brother Arrath, I was never certain which of them ran the theory sessions on repurposed threat — had said something along those lines once.

subject: Brother Arrath
fact: Brother Arrath may have run theory sessions on repurposed threat, though Zalthir is uncertain.
source_quote: Brother Heslin — or possibly Brother Arrath, I was never certain which of them ran the theory sessions on repurposed threat — had said something along those lines once.

subject: Janussi
fact: Janussi is the Keeper of Tomes who was dead before the party arrived at Candlekeep.
source_quote: Somewhere inside Candlekeep, the Keeper of Tomes was dead

subject: Avowed
fact: One Avowed died in the Dragon Breath Simulation Chamber.
source_quote: One of the Avowed had died in it

subject: Avowed
fact: The Avowed are a group within Candlekeep who require permission to use the Dragon Breath Simulation Chamber.
source_quote: the Avowed were still asleep. [...] the Keeper's permission was now required.

subject: House of the Binder
fact: Books for the party will be copied at the House of the Binder upon successful completion of the investigation.
source_quote: One book each, copied at the House of the Binder, upon successful completion.

subject: Dawnbringer
fact: Dawnbringer is a sword housed in her scabbard that claims to have been found after two thousand years.
source_quote: Dawnbringer, housed in her scabbard, took the opportunity to note that we must surely be the greatest discoverers of all, having found her tomb after two thousand years.

subject: Grygumite School
fact: The Grygumite School is a newly declared school of thought that captured the council's interest.
source_quote: I am the head of the Grygumite School." A beat. "Founder, in fact.

subject: Poirot and Colombo
fact: Thorin and Grygum claim to be students of the great Masters Poirot and Colombo.
source_quote: Thorin said we were students of the great Masters Poirot and Colombo

subject: new philosophy of the universe
fact: Grygum claims to have found a new philosophy of the universe.
source_quote: And I have found a new philosophy of the universe.

subject: fixed points
fact: Grygum references 'fixed points' as a possible theological framework for the investigation.
source_quote: It could be one of those fixed points

subject: repurposed threat
fact: Brother Heslin or Brother Arrath taught a theory about repurposing dangerous entities into knowledge repositories.
source_quote: Brother Heslin — or possibly Brother Arrath, I was never certain which of them ran the theory sessions on repurposed threat — had said something along those lines once.

subject: day of Janussi's death
fact: Janussi asked Kalan to resign the morning before his death.
source_quote: yesterday morning, Janussi asked the gate warden to tender his resignation.

subject: gray ooze
fact: Daz references fungal scourges from Underdark investigations, implying past encounters with hazardous biological entities.
source_quote: Underdark investigations, multiple factions, fungal scourges

subject: fungal scourges
fact: Fungal scourges are hazardous biological entities encountered during Underdark investigations.
source_quote: Underdark investigations, multiple factions, fungal scourges

subject: notes
fact: Zalthir picked up his notes before following the messenger.
source_quote: I picked up my notes.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool watches the party from the corner with patient attentiveness after acquiring eyes.
source_quote: Glabbagool had been watching from the corner with the patient attentiveness he'd developed since acquiring eyes.

subject: bag of holding
fact: Glabbagool resides inside a bag of holding and peers out from its opening.
source_quote: He flowed toward the bag, arranged himself inside it, and peered out from the opening with two eyeballs tracking the room.

subject: Imbros
fact: Imbros is referenced as having read Vof Klownits's opus, though this is not directly stated in the text.

subject: Vof Klownits
fact: Vof Klownits is a Sage whose opus is referenced by Imbros, though not mentioned in the provided text.

subject: Bahamut text
fact: Grygum reads the room the way he reads a Bahamut text — for what is conspicuously not said.
source_quote: I read the room the way I read a Bahamut text — not for what it says, but for what it is conspicuously not saying.
